author: Hotta, Eri
title: Japan 1941: Countdown to Infamy
notes: The Japanese decision for war, from Japanese sources: the liaison conferences of 1941 and an argument that few of the men in them believed the war could be won and none was willing to be the one to say so. The counterpart on the Japanese side to what source:clark-2012 and source:fischer-1967 are to July 1914 in this registry — a decision-for-war study, to be cited for what the participants said and as one reading of why. Verified against catalogue records only; no ISBN is recorded.
